excerpt: The 5 commissioned strings work well and are expected to start taking science data with the rest of the detector in fall 2026. The recently deployed IceCube Upgrade is presently in its commissioning phase before its integration into the IceCube data acquisition.
publisher: arXiv (A. Eimer for the IceCube Collaboration)
title: IceCube Upgrade status and perspectives (CRIS-MAC 2026 proceedings)
